videos.description: Build an autonomous desktop and web research agent that connects via MCP to local filesystem, PostgreSQL database, and external search tools to execute complex research briefs.
checkpoints: Implement a custom FastMCP server exposing structured database and file tools
Build a stateful LangGraph agent orchestrating multi-step research execution
Implement human-in-the-loop confirmation before running destructive actions

videos.title: Project 2: Enterprise Production RAG with Hybrid Search & Neural Reranker
videos.description: Architect a high-performance RAG pipeline indexing 100,000+ technical documents using PGVector HNSW, BM25 hybrid fusion, and Cohere neural reranking with RAGAS evaluation.
checkpoints: Build semantic chunking and metadata extraction pipeline with Pydantic
Implement Reciprocal Rank Fusion combining dense embeddings and BM25
Add automated RAGAS evaluation suite testing Faithfulness and Relevance in CI/CD

videos.title: Project 3: Real-Time Sub-500ms Conversational Voice Agent
videos.description: Develop a real-time voice-to-voice bot using WebRTC, LiveKit Agents, Silero VAD, streaming Faster-Whisper transcription, and Kokoro neural speech synthesis.
checkpoints: Establish low-latency WebRTC audio streaming pipeline with LiveKit
Implement conversational turn-taking and user speech interruption handling
Optimize end-to-end voice roundtrip latency below 500ms

videos.title: Project 4: Domain-Specialized LLM Fine-Tuning Pipeline with QLoRA & DPO
videos.description: Fine-tune an open-source 8B parameter model (LLaMA 3 or Mistral) on technical code and API documentation using QLoRA 4-bit quantization, followed by DPO alignment.
checkpoints: Curate and clean a domain dataset with strict instruction-response pairs
Fine-tune with Unsloth / Hugging Face TRL using QLoRA adapters
Execute DPO alignment and evaluate win-rate against the base foundation model

videos.title: Project 5: High-Throughput vLLM Inference Gateway with Semantic Cache
videos.description: Deploy an enterprise-grade OpenAI-compatible inference gateway fronted by FastAPI, Redis semantic vector caching, continuous batching on vLLM, and Prometheus metrics.
checkpoints: Serve 4-bit quantized open model with vLLM PagedAttention continuous batching
Implement two-tier semantic caching layer reducing redundant API costs by 60%
Expose Prometheus metrics for latency p95/p99, throughput (tokens/sec), and queue depth
